title: Codify CloudFront subfolder-rewrite function in Terraform + reconcile alias drift
description: Staging 403'd on /work/ /about/ /contact/ /card/ because CloudFront uses the OAC private S3 REST origin (bucket .s3.amazonaws.com), which bypasses the bucket's website index_document config, and there was no URL-rewrite function. Fixed on staging (dist E1YUW51SH9S8G2) via CLI: created+published CloudFront Function 'jdnguyen-spa-rewrite' (viewer-request) rewriting trailing-slash and extensionless paths to /index.html, associated on DefaultCacheBehavior. This is currently DRIFT — not in Terraform. TODO: (1) add aws_cloudfront_function + function_association{event_type=viewer-request} to terraform/modules/website/main.tf; (2) reconcile the pre-existing alias drift (module has aliases=[] but live distro has the domain alias) before any terraform apply, or apply will drop the alias and break routing; (3) apply to staging then production. Function code saved pattern: if uri ends with '/' append index.html, else if last path segment has no '.' append /index.html.
acceptance_criteria: CloudFront function is defined in Terraform and associated via IaC; terraform plan shows no unexpected alias/origin removal; subfolder routes serve their index.html on both envs.

title: Email deliverability: SPF/DKIM/DMARC for jdnguyen.tech
description: The About page claims 'email that does not land in spam.' Make it true: configure SPF, DKIM (via Resend and/or SES), and a DMARC policy on jdnguyen.tech in Cloudflare DNS. Prerequisite for both contact-form backends delivering reliably.

title: Deploy Cloudflare Worker contact form and wire endpoint
description: Deploy workers/contact/ (Resend-backed). Steps: verify jdnguyen.tech in Resend (adds DKIM), wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY, wrangler deploy, expose via api.jdnguyen.tech (proxied) or workers.dev URL, then set CONTACT_ENDPOINT in website_v2/assets/form.js. Until then the form falls back to the mailto message.
acceptance_criteria: Form submits successfully end to end; enquiry email arrives and is not in spam; honeypot drops bots.

title: Add real portrait and case-study images (grayscale)
description: About page has a 4:5 portrait .imgslot placeholder; Work page has three 4:3 case-study .imgslot placeholders. Replace with real optimized images (webp/avif + fallback) inside the .grayscale wrapper. Case-study count/content is configurable.

title: Self-host Archivo font (remove Google Fonts hotlink)
description: website_v2/assets/styles.css @imports Archivo from Google Fonts. Self-host woff2 (weights 400/600/800) with font-display:swap and preload, for Lighthouse and privacy. Update the @import to a local @font-face.

title: Contact form via Lambda + API Gateway + SES (AWS-native alternative)
description: Alternative to the Cloudflare Worker contact handler in workers/contact/. Implement the contact form backend AWS-natively: API Gateway -> Lambda -> SES, kept in Terraform alongside the rest of the infra so the whole stack lives in one IaC state (portfolio flex: the site sells AWS Solutions Architect skills). Should accept the same JSON payload {name,business,email,message,company_website honeypot}, validate, and email hello@jdnguyen.tech. Requires SES domain verification + moving out of the SES sandbox. Swap CONTACT_ENDPOINT in website_v2/assets/form.js when live.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform-managed API Gateway+Lambda+SES endpoint accepting the form payload; validated; emails deliver DKIM-signed; form.js points at it; Worker retired or kept as fallback.
